# Six example covers capture light on examples that offer Neo Dark

## Context

The Portal's Examples catalog renders on Neo Dark. Clio's look read of the group pages (Sat 21 Nov) found light covers on examples that offer `neo-theme-neo-dark`. Two of the eight she named (`gantt-basic`, `scheduler-basic`) were already refreshed in Neo Dark by neomjs/pages#153. Six remain, measured as the mean luminance (0–255) of each 1280 × 720 cover on `neomjs/pages` `main` at `99b5fd8d9e`:

| Cover | Luma | | Dark covers, for scale | Luma |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grid-export` | 231.8 | | `gantt-basic` | 28.1 |
| `grid-locked-columns` | 242.4 | | `scheduler-basic` | 31.3 |
| `list-reorder` | 230.2 | | `grid-countries` | 43.9 |
| `live-preview` | 246.6 | | `table-filtering` | 28.6 |
| `mermaid` | 249.3 | | | |
| `sparklines` | 237.8 | | | |

## The Problem

On the dark catalog the six read as white cards. With the hover and select card states of #21676, a light cover on a dark page is the case that reads weakest.

Each of the six lists `neo-theme-neo-dark` in its `neo-config.json` and offers a theme control on the page, so a dark cover shows a state its visitor reaches in one click.

## The Architectural Reality

- Recipes live in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`. `"theme": "dark"` gives the capture's browser context `colorScheme: 'dark'` (`buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs:391`); the page itself switches through a recipe step. #21656's shape for #21573 clicks the example's own control and asserts `.neo-viewport.neo-theme-neo-dark` in `after`.
- Theme controls on `dev`: a `Dark theme` button in `grid-export` (`examples/grid/export/MainContainer.mjs:73`), `grid-locked-columns` (`examples/grid/pinnedColumns/MainContainer.mjs:62`) and `live-preview` (`examples/code/livePreview/MainContainer.mjs:74`); `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (#21704's rollout) in `mermaid` (`examples/component/wrapper/mermaid/MainContainer.mjs:58`), `list-reorder` (`examples/list/reorder/MainContainer.mjs:48`) and `sparklines` (`examples/component/sparkline/MainContainer.mjs:79`).
- Covers publish to `neomjs/pages` at `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/<id>-14.jpg` through a companion pull request, as neomjs/pages#148 did for #21656.

## The Fix

1. The six recipes move to `"theme": "dark"`, with a step that switches the page through its own control and an `after` assertion on the dark theme class.
2. `captureExamples.mjs` re-captures the six, and a companion `neomjs/pages` pull request publishes them.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: The six recipes capture their page on neo-dark, and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` passes.
- [x] AC-2: The six new covers are on `neomjs/pages` `main`, each measured with a mean luma below 80 by the same read as Context.
- [x] AC-3: Clio's look read of the six covers is recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] Post-merge: the Portal's catalog shows the six dark covers after the next Pages deploy.

## Out of Scope

- Examples whose `neo-config.json` offers no dark theme: their light cover is what a visitor sees.
- Tiles: the tile recipe already crops each workbench on its dark theme (`captureExamples.mjs:16`).
